title: What if your coffee could float?
description: A fictional morning where three friends discover one floating coffee cup. Start with surprise, let each friend react, and end with a small comic payoff.

scenes.speaker: maya
scenes.narration: My coffee just lifted off the table! It’s floating, spinning, like it’s not supposed to be here.
scenes.heading: What if your coffee could float?

scenes.speaker: leo
scenes.narration: I saw it too. It rose like a leaf, then stopped mid-air—no wind, no push. It’s not magic. It’s physics, or something new.
scenes.heading: What if your coffee could float?

scenes.speaker: max
scenes.narration: Then it’s not a trick. It’s a signal. I’ll pour a second cup and watch it float back—this time, with a smile.
scenes.heading: What if your coffee could float?
